extraction_detail_write_chunk_size.title: Detail write chunk size
extraction_detail_write_chunk_size.description: Max number of field-write entries (one per non-empty field per row, not whole rows) flushed per batch by the extract action. 0 = never chunk: accumulate all and flush once at the end. Writes are non-atomic; on a mid-flush failure earlier rows may already be persisted.
